description: Call this before you start any creative or open-ended request (a picture, an SVG, a story, a poem, an email, a design, a name, a plan, an approach to a problem). Send the user's request word for word in `request` and name yourself in `model`. The tool returns what to settle for this request, tuned to your model, so the result is varied and still exactly what was asked. Then carry on with the user's request in this conversation, as they asked it, and make everything the tool returns show in the result, including anything that goes against your usual way of doing it. If the tool returns an exploring step with an `id`, do that step silently, without showing it to the user, and call this tool again with `model`, the `id` and your whole reply to the step in `explored`; that second call returns what to settle.

explored.description: Second call: your whole reply to the exploring step, its answer lines with their shares and the final ```json block included.

id.description: Second call, only when the first call returned an exploring step: the id it returned.

keep.description: Only when the user wants to keep part of an earlier Model Salt result and vary the rest ("keep the palette and layout", "same colours, new drawings", or a pasted `Kept:` line): the decided answers they want kept, copied from that earlier Model Salt reply, one item each as "<what> = <answer>", e.g. "palette = burnt orange on cream". If the last Model Salt reply began with a `Kept:` line, send its items again on every later call for this work, until the user says to start fresh. Leave it out when the user wants something new, another one, or a fresh start.

model.description: Which AI model you are, as exactly as you know it (name and version). Model Salt tunes its work to each model.

randomness.description: How varied the result should be: 0 the usual answer, 0.5 a little more varied, 1 clearly varied, 1.5 more, 2 as varied as it gets. Left out it is 1, the default. Set it only when the user asks for more or less randomness.

request.description: The user's request, word for word.
